// In-process job queue with per-job retry, exponential backoff and a dead-letter
// list. Used by the webhook dispatcher: a delivery that fails is retried up to
// `maxAttempts` times, then parked where an operator can inspect and replay it.
//
// Nothing here is durable. The queue is rebuilt from the outbox table on boot;
// this module only decides WHEN a job runs and what happens when it fails.

export type JobStatus = "queued" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "dead";

export interface Job<T> {
  id: string;
  kind: string;
  payload: T;
  status: JobStatus;
  attempts: number;
  enqueuedAt: string;
  runAfter: number;
  lastError?: string;
  finishedAt?: string;
}

export interface QueueOptions {
  concurrency: number;
  maxAttempts: number;
  baseDelayMs: number;
  maxDelayMs: number;
  /** 0..1 — fraction of the delay randomised to avoid thundering herds. */
  jitter: number;
  now: () => number;
  random: () => number;
  onEvent?: (event: QueueEvent) => void;
}

export type QueueEvent =
  | { type: "enqueued"; id: string; kind: string }
  | { type: "started"; id: string; attempt: number }
  | { type: "succeeded"; id: string; attempt: number; tookMs: number }
  | { type: "retry"; id: string; attempt: number; delayMs: number; error: string }
  | { type: "dead"; id: string; attempts: number; error: string };

export type Handler<T> = (payload: T, job: Readonly<Job<T>>) => Promise<void>;

/** Thrown by a handler to say "do not retry this one". */
export class PermanentError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, readonly cause?: unknown) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "PermanentError";
  }
}

export class QueueClosedError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super("queue is closed");
    this.name = "QueueClosedError";
  }
}

const DEFAULTS: QueueOptions = {
  concurrency: 4,
  maxAttempts: 5,
  baseDelayMs: 500,
  maxDelayMs: 60_000,
  jitter: 0.2,
  now: () => Date.now(),
  random: () => Math.random(),
};

/** Delay before attempt N+1, given N failures so far. Pure. */
export function backoffDelay(failures: number, opts: Pick<QueueOptions, "baseDelayMs" | "maxDelayMs" | "jitter">, rand = 0.5): number {
  if (failures <= 0) return 0;
  const exp = Math.min(opts.maxDelayMs, opts.baseDelayMs * 2 ** (failures - 1));
  const spread = exp * opts.jitter;
  // rand in [0,1) maps to [-spread, +spread)
  const jittered = exp - spread + rand * 2 * spread;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(opts.maxDelayMs, Math.round(jittered)));
}

export function describeError(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    const cause = (error as { cause?: unknown }).cause;
    return cause === undefined ? `${error.name}: ${error.message}` : `${error.name}: ${error.message} (caused by ${describeError(cause)})`;
  }
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(error);
  } catch {
    return String(error);
  }
}

export class RetryQueue<T> {
  private readonly opts: QueueOptions;
  private readonly handlers = new Map<string, Handler<T>>();
  private readonly jobs = new Map<string, Job<T>>();
  private readonly dead: Job<T>[] = [];
  private running = 0;
  private closed = false;
  private seq = 0;

  constructor(options: Partial<QueueOptions> = {}) {
    this.opts = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    if (this.opts.concurrency < 1) throw new Error(`concurrency must be >= 1, got ${this.opts.concurrency}`);
    if (this.opts.maxAttempts < 1) throw new Error(`maxAttempts must be >= 1, got ${this.opts.maxAttempts}`);
    if (this.opts.jitter < 0 || this.opts.jitter > 1) throw new Error(`jitter must be within 0..1, got ${this.opts.jitter}`);
  }

  on(kind: string, handler: Handler<T>): this {
    if (this.handlers.has(kind)) throw new Error(`handler for "${kind}" is already registered`);
    this.handlers.set(kind, handler);
    return this;
  }

  enqueue(kind: string, payload: T, id?: string): Job<T> {
    if (this.closed) throw new QueueClosedError();
    if (!this.handlers.has(kind)) throw new Error(`no handler registered for "${kind}"`);
    const jobId = id ?? `job-${(++this.seq).toString().padStart(6, "0")}`;
    const existing = this.jobs.get(jobId);
    if (existing) {
      // Idempotent enqueue: the outbox replays rows on boot.
      return existing;
    }
    const job: Job<T> = {
      id: jobId,
      kind,
      payload,
      status: "queued",
      attempts: 0,
      enqueuedAt: new Date(this.opts.now()).toISOString(),
      runAfter: this.opts.now(),
    };
    this.jobs.set(jobId, job);
    this.emit({ type: "enqueued", id: jobId, kind });
    return job;
  }

  /** Jobs that may start now, oldest `runAfter` first. */
  ready(): Job<T>[] {
    const now = this.opts.now();
    return [...this.jobs.values()]
      .filter((job) => job.status === "queued" && job.runAfter <= now)
      .sort((a, b) => a.runAfter - b.runAfter || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  }

  /**
   * Start as many ready jobs as the concurrency limit allows and resolve when
   * the ones started by THIS call have settled. Returns how many it started.
   */
  async pump(): Promise<number> {
    if (this.closed) throw new QueueClosedError();
    const batch: Promise<void>[] = [];
    for (const job of this.ready()) {
      if (this.running >= this.opts.concurrency) break;
      batch.push(this.run(job));
    }
    await Promise.all(batch);
    return batch.length;
  }

  private async run(job: Job<T>): Promise<void> {
    const handler = this.handlers.get(job.kind);
    if (!handler) {
      this.bury(job, `no handler registered for "${job.kind}"`);
      return;
    }
    this.running++;
    job.status = "running";
    job.attempts++;
    const startedAt = this.opts.now();
    this.emit({ type: "started", id: job.id, attempt: job.attempts });
    try {
      await handler(job.payload, job);
      job.status = "succeeded";
      job.finishedAt = new Date(this.opts.now()).toISOString();
      this.emit({ type: "succeeded", id: job.id, attempt: job.attempts, tookMs: this.opts.now() - startedAt });
      this.jobs.delete(job.id);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = describeError(error);
      job.lastError = message;
      if (error instanceof PermanentError || job.attempts >= this.opts.maxAttempts) {
        this.bury(job, message);
      } else {
        const delayMs = backoffDelay(job.attempts, this.opts, this.opts.random());
        job.status = "queued";
        job.runAfter = this.opts.now() + delayMs;
        this.emit({ type: "retry", id: job.id, attempt: job.attempts, delayMs, error: message });
      }
    } finally {
      this.running--;
    }
  }

  private bury(job: Job<T>, error: string): void {
    job.status = "dead";
    job.lastError = error;
    job.finishedAt = new Date(this.opts.now()).toISOString();
    this.jobs.delete(job.id);
    this.dead.push(job);
    console.error(`[retry-queue] job ${job.id} (${job.kind}) is dead after ${job.attempts} attempt(s): ${error}`);
    this.emit({ type: "dead", id: job.id, attempts: job.attempts, error });
  }

  /** Put a dead job back in the queue with a clean attempt counter. */
  replay(id: string): Job<T> {
    const index = this.dead.findIndex((job) => job.id === id);
    if (index < 0) throw new Error(`no dead job with id "${id}"`);
    const [job] = this.dead.splice(index, 1);
    const revived: Job<T> = { ...job, status: "queued", attempts: 0, runAfter: this.opts.now(), lastError: undefined, finishedAt: undefined };
    this.jobs.set(revived.id, revived);
    return revived;
  }

  deadLetters(): readonly Job<T>[] {
    return this.dead;
  }

  size(): { queued: number; running: number; dead: number } {
    let queued = 0;
    for (const job of this.jobs.values()) if (job.status === "queued") queued++;
    return { queued, running: this.running, dead: this.dead.length };
  }

  /** Milliseconds until the next queued job is due, or null if none is queued. */
  nextDueIn(): number | null {
    let soonest: number | null = null;
    for (const job of this.jobs.values()) {
      if (job.status !== "queued") continue;
      if (soonest === null || job.runAfter < soonest) soonest = job.runAfter;
    }
    return soonest === null ? null : Math.max(0, soonest - this.opts.now());
  }

  close(): void {
    this.closed = true;
  }

  private emit(event: QueueEvent): void {
    try {
      this.opts.onEvent?.(event);
    } catch (error) {
      // A broken observer must never take the queue down with it.
      console.warn(`[retry-queue] onEvent threw for ${event.type}: ${describeError(error)}`);
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// Self-test. `bun retry-queue.ts --self-test` — kept next to the code because
// the backoff table below is the contract the dispatcher's alerting relies on.
// ============================================================================

interface Delivery {
  url: string;
  body: string;
  signature: string;
}

const FIXED_NOW = Date.parse("2026-03-14T09:26:53.000Z");

const DELIVERIES: Array<{ id: string; payload: Delivery }> = [
  {
    id: "7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7",
    payload: { url: "https://hooks.example.test/a", body: '{"event":"invoice.paid"}', signature: "9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08" },
  },
  {
    id: "3d6f0a1e-9b2c-4f7a-8e5d-1c2b3a4d5e6f",
    payload: { url: "https://hooks.example.test/b", body: '{"event":"invoice.failed"}', signature: "2fd4e1c67a2d28fced849ee1bb76e7391b93eb12" },
  },
  {
    id: "0b8f4c2d-5e6a-4b1c-9d7e-2f3a4b5c6d7e",
    payload: { url: "https://hooks.example.test/gone", body: "{}", signature: "da39a3ee5e6b4b0d3255bfef95601890afd80709" },
  },
];

function assertEqual<V>(actual: V, expected: V, label: string): void {
  const a = JSON.stringify(actual);
  const e = JSON.stringify(expected);
  if (a !== e) throw new Error(`${label}: expected ${e}, got ${a}`);
}

export async function selfTest(): Promise<string[]> {
  const log: string[] = [];
  let clock = FIXED_NOW;
  const events: QueueEvent[] = [];
  const queue = new RetryQueue<Delivery>({
    concurrency: 2,
    maxAttempts: 3,
    baseDelayMs: 1_000,
    maxDelayMs: 8_000,
    jitter: 0,
    now: () => clock,
    random: () => 0.5,
    onEvent: (event) => events.push(event),
  });

  const failuresLeft = new Map<string, number>([[DELIVERIES[1].id, 2]]);
  queue.on("webhook", async (payload, job) => {
    if (payload.url.endsWith("/gone")) throw new PermanentError("410 Gone", new Error("endpoint removed"));
    const left = failuresLeft.get(job.id) ?? 0;
    if (left > 0) {
      failuresLeft.set(job.id, left - 1);
      throw new Error(`502 from ${payload.url}`);
    }
  });

  // Backoff table: no jitter, doubles, capped.
  const table = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => backoffDelay(n, { baseDelayMs: 1_000, maxDelayMs: 8_000, jitter: 0 }));
  assertEqual(table, [1_000, 2_000, 4_000, 8_000, 8_000, 8_000], "backoff table");
  assertEqual(backoffDelay(3, { baseDelayMs: 1_000, maxDelayMs: 8_000, jitter: 0.25 }, 0), 3_000, "jitter low edge");
  assertEqual(backoffDelay(3, { baseDelayMs: 1_000, maxDelayMs: 8_000, jitter: 0.25 }, 1), 5_000, "jitter high edge");
  assertEqual(backoffDelay(0, DEFAULTS), 0, "no failures, no delay");

  for (const delivery of DELIVERIES) queue.enqueue("webhook", delivery.payload, delivery.id);
  assertEqual(queue.enqueue("webhook", DELIVERIES[0].payload, DELIVERIES[0].id).enqueuedAt, "2026-03-14T09:26:53.000Z", "idempotent enqueue");
  assertEqual(queue.size(), { queued: 3, running: 0, dead: 0 }, "after enqueue");

  // Round 1: concurrency 2 means the third job waits for the next pump.
  assertEqual(await queue.pump(), 2, "first pump starts two");
  assertEqual(await queue.pump(), 1, "second pump starts the third");
  assertEqual(queue.size(), { queued: 1, running: 0, dead: 1 }, "after round 1");
  assertEqual(queue.deadLetters()[0].lastError, "PermanentError: 410 Gone (caused by Error: endpoint removed)", "permanent error is not retried");
  assertEqual(queue.nextDueIn(), 1_000, "retry scheduled one base delay out");

  // Round 2: not due yet, then due and failing again.
  assertEqual(await queue.pump(), 0, "nothing is due before the delay");
  clock += 1_000;
  assertEqual(await queue.pump(), 1, "retry runs when due");
  assertEqual(queue.nextDueIn(), 2_000, "second retry doubles");

  // Round 3: third attempt succeeds.
  clock += 2_000;
  assertEqual(await queue.pump(), 1, "final attempt runs");
  assertEqual(queue.size(), { queued: 0, running: 0, dead: 1 }, "drained");

  const retries = events.filter((event) => event.type === "retry");
  assertEqual(retries.length, 2, "two retries recorded");
  assertEqual(events.filter((event) => event.type === "succeeded").length, 2, "two deliveries succeeded");

  // Replay the dead letter after the endpoint comes back.
  const revived = queue.replay(DELIVERIES[2].id);
  assertEqual([revived.status, revived.attempts], ["queued", 0], "replay resets the job");
  queue.close();
  let closedError = "";
  try {
    await queue.pump();
  } catch (error) {
    closedError = describeError(error);
  }
  assertEqual(closedError, "QueueClosedError: queue is closed", "closed queue refuses work");

  log.push(`ok ${events.length} events, ${retries.length} retries, finished at ${new Date(clock).toISOString()}`);
  return log;
}

declare const process: { argv: string[]; exit(code: number): never } | undefined;

if (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.argv.includes("--self-test")) {
  selfTest()
    .then((lines) => {
      for (const line of lines) console.log(line);
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error(`self-test FAILED: ${describeError(error)}`);
      process.exit(1);
    });
}
